prompt:
Create a high-fidelity mobile landing page for the fictional Minsk coffee roastery «Кварта», edge to edge on a 9:16 portrait canvas: a 390 CSS-pixel-wide phone viewport rendered at retina resolution, with readable Russian UI. Show the opening and start of the next section, no browser or device frame. The two references are visual-system inspiration adapted into a working coffee page, never copied layout or travel content. Keep the four-ink print world. Use only the text wordmark «Кварта»: no tree logos, mountains, park emblems or outdoor travel imagery, including on coffee packs.

The visitor buys fresh beans for home and leaves a callback request. One coherent illustrated roasting-workshop scene carries the opening: small roaster, beans and Kvarta coffee packs, showing Thursday's roast becoming Friday's coffee. The headline belongs within that unified scene; never put copy beside an illustration as a split hero. Beneath the scene, readable offer and one single-column callback form hold in quiet surfaces of the same print world. It must function as a roastery website, not a poster. Compact header: text wordmark and menu; menu links «Кофе», «Подписка», «Доставка».

Copy: «Свежий кофе к пятнице», «В четверг обжариваем — в пятницу привозим». Facts: 5 kg batches, Thursday roasting, Friday Minsk delivery. Offer: «Кофе от 26 BYN», «Подписка · 54 BYN / месяц», two 250 g packs monthly, delivery included.

The form has clearly labelled usable fields «Имя», «Телефон» stacked in one column, one mutually exclusive interest group containing «Разовый заказ», «Подписка», «Вопрос», optional «Комментарий», and prominent «Оставить заявку» button. Include «Перезвоним и поможем с выбором». At the lower edge begin a distinct calm section «Что обжариваем» and «Эфиопия Иргачеффе · 250 г · 32 BYN». No other origin tasting description. No invented testimonials, discounts, metrics, claims or phone contacts.
